purpose: Map Unity flight-feel intent and browser seams for a browser-native RCS/SAS parity implementation plan without treating Unity code as a 1:1 port target.
scopeNotes: Analysis/spec only; no product implementation in this package.

Do not touch apps/weltraum-browser/src/**, apps/weltraum-browser/tests/**, apps/weltraum-browser/evidence/*.png, apps/weltraum-browser/package.json, apps/weltraum-browser/package-lock.json, or Assets/** in this analysis branch.
Browser parity must remain independent from current Demo Scout GLB/ShipVisual work and from Unity Rigidbody/nozzle hierarchy details.

unitySources.role: Primary Unity player-flight authority, mode/input routing, assist integration, and control diagnostics source.

behaviorsByTopic.modes: FlightControlMode.Normal is labeled Cruise; Precision and Translation are RCS-driven; mode cycling is Cruise -> Precision -> Translation -> Cruise; non-Cruise modes force RCS on and disable manual main-thruster/gimbal authority.
behaviorsByTopic.throttle: Persistent main throttle supports cut/full/ramp controls and is separated from actual main-thruster module response.
behaviorsByTopic.rcs: RCS can be toggled and supplies attitude and translation paths; Precision/Translation rely on RCS authority.
behaviorsByTopic.sas: SAS supports KillRotation/HoldAttitude concepts with effective/inverted state, target rotation updates, manual-axis masking, and assist interaction.
behaviorsByTopic.assist: Waypoint autopilot and momentum assist can request force, torque, and main throttle; assist ownership should not be copied blindly.
behaviorsByTopic.diagnostics: Control diagnostics include RCS enabled/available/status, SAS state/authority, mode, throttle, main/gimbal allowance, autopilot, and momentum assist state.

browserPlanningUse: Use as semantic source for mode labels, authority boundaries, throttle terminology, RCS/SAS status, and HUD diagnostics.
Do not port Unity Rigidbody wiring, hidden assist ownership, or exact key/mode internals without browser product decision.

unitySources.role: Main-thruster bank coordination and aggregate runtime/telemetry source.

behaviorsByTopic.mainThruster: Coordinates main thruster modules, aggregate thrust, force, torque, gimbal, power draw, and throttle runtime data.
behaviorsByTopic.throttle: Provides target-vs-actual throttle/spool values used by PlayerShipController diagnostics.
behaviorsByTopic.diagnostics: Separates requested throttle/gimbal state from applied runtime output.

browserPlanningUse: Use as reference for commanded-vs-applied throttle telemetry and main-thrust active/intensity fields.
Do not copy module hierarchy or physical nozzle force implementation directly.

unitySources.role: Related main-thruster module implementing spool, gimbal lag, thermal/fuel gating, and force/torque output.

behaviorsByTopic.throttle: Persistent throttle is spooled toward a target before being applied.
behaviorsByTopic.gimbal: Target and actual gimbal commands can diverge because of slew/lag.
behaviorsByTopic.mainThruster: COM-safe steering and fully physical nozzle force are separate Unity modes; thermal/fuel gating can reduce output.

browserPlanningUse: Use as a feel reference for throttle ramp and VFX intensity only.
Do not import thermal/fuel hard-zero behavior into browser parity unless a later spec requires it.

unitySources.role: RCS solver/allocation, SAS command, nozzle runtime, and diagnostics source.

behaviorsByTopic.rcs: Stable prototype and experimental physical-nozzle solvers produce force/torque output and authority diagnostics.
behaviorsByTopic.sas: SAS command participates in RCS allocation, including masks and authority status.
behaviorsByTopic.diagnostics: Reports actual/residual force and torque, allocator status, nozzle counts, saturation, fuel requested/consumed, active nozzle IDs, SAS masks, and torque authority.
behaviorsByTopic.visualization: VFX is tied to nozzle activity/throttle rather than a single global RCS flag.

browserPlanningUse: Use as checklist for browser RCS diagnostics and per-marker visualization seams.
Do not copy stable-vs-experimental allocator mechanics or Unity child-nozzle discovery as browser architecture.

unitySources.role: Player-facing HUD snapshot, status label, warning chip, and assist chip source.

behaviorsByTopic.hud: Shows flight mode, throttle, fuel, main/RCS/SAS labels, warnings, assist chips, radar, and target indicators.
behaviorsByTopic.labels: Maps state into readable strings such as Main ready, Main disabled by mode, RCS ready/off/no authority, and SAS on/inverted/off/ineffective.
behaviorsByTopic.diagnostics: Separates player-readable status from deeper debug surfaces.

browserPlanningUse: Use as UX reference for clear HUD/status messaging.
Do not port IMGUI layout or debug preset structure as browser player UI.

unitySources.role: Runtime snapshot/data-contract source for ship state, RCS allocation, and camera visual bounds.

behaviorsByTopic.telemetry: Defines runtime data shapes for ship state and diagnostics.
behaviorsByTopic.rcsDiagnostics: RcsNozzleData and allocation request/result structs describe nozzle pose, throttle/spool/cache data, requested/effective output, and allocation results.
behaviorsByTopic.cameraFeel: Camera visual bounds are data, not flight authority.

browserPlanningUse: Use as source-map reference for browser telemetry field planning.
Keep browser telemetry smaller and Playwright-readable.

unitySources.role: Current Unity prototype behavior, HUD/debug, control, and verification contract summary.

behaviorsByTopic.controls: Documents Cruise/Precision/Translation, RCS, SAS, camera modes, and control overlays.
behaviorsByTopic.hud: Basic HUD includes flight status, fuel/throttle/RCS/SAS, warning/assist chips, radar, Kill Momentum, contextual panels, and F1 help.
behaviorsByTopic.verification: Documents Unity validation commands, but this analysis package intentionally did not run tests/builds.

browserPlanningUse: Use as current Unity intent snapshot and terminology source.
Do not treat Unity validation commands as required for this browser analysis-only branch.

browserOrientationAnchors.currentState: Defines FlightControlMode = Cruise | Precision | Translation; ShipState already carries controlMode, rcsEnabled, sasEnabled, mainThrottleCommand, translationCommand, rotationCommand, actuatorTelemetry, angularVelocity, and orientation.
remainingGaps: Telemetry is actuator-level rather than player-explanatory.
No per-nozzle/per-marker diagnostic data shape yet.
No explicit applied-throttle/spool fields beyond current throttle/mainThrottleCommand.

browserOrientationAnchors.currentState: Defines CameraMode, ManualFlightInputState, controlModes = [Cruise, Precision, Translation], default Cruise/RCS-on/SAS-on/throttle-zero state, and merge/cycle helpers.
remainingGaps: Mode input exists, but Precision still needs a distinct feel contract.
Future implementation must verify final keybindings against browser controls and evidence scenarios.

browserOrientationAnchors.currentState: applyFlightControllerStep already gates main thrust to Cruise, RCS translation to Translation unless explicitly allowed, RCS rotation by RCS authority, and SAS damping by sasEnabled/sasAvailable/rcsEnabled; actuator telemetry exposes active flags and applied acceleration/angular acceleration.
remainingGaps: Precision has little/no distinct behavior beyond mode gating.
Throttle command is applied directly; no target-vs-actual ramp/spool model.
SAS is damping-only and lacks readable effectiveness/hold-defer decision.

browserOrientationAnchors.currentState: Executor owns manual/autopilot handoff, idle/manual preservation, planHash/replanRequired telemetry, Cruise autopilot requests, and no-snap/no-idle-zero-sensitive behavior.
remainingGaps: New flight-feel changes must not introduce hidden replans, snap-to-target, or idle zeroing.
New telemetry must preserve existing flightSnapshot/position/velocity status.

notOneToOnePortRules: Do not copy Unity Rigidbody force/torque integration into browser simulation.
Do not mirror Unity child-object nozzle discovery, VFX binding, or imported socket names.
Do not copy stable-vs-experimental RCS allocator mechanics unless a focused diagnostic slice explicitly requires it.
Do not replicate hidden assist-owned main throttle/gimbal behavior without product decision.
Do not treat the H/N translation split as settled; verify browser controls and evidence first.
Do not port IMGUI debug surfaces/presets as player-facing browser UI.
Do not implement Unity fuel/thermal hard-zero behavior as part of this parity slice unless separately specified.
Do not reintroduce snap-to-destination, executor-side replanning, or idle velocity zeroing.

parityTopics.manualFlightFeelTuning: Mode-specific input response, authority, damping, and player-readable telemetry.
parityTopics.throttleRampAndInertia: Commanded vs applied throttle, deterministic spool/ramp, main-thrust active/intensity telemetry.
parityTopics.cruisePrecisionTranslation: Cruise keeps main-thrust feel; Precision becomes fine/RCS attitude profile; Translation emphasizes RCS linear movement.
parityTopics.rcsTranslationVsRotation: Separate RCS translation and rotation commands/effective outputs in behavior and telemetry.
parityTopics.sasDampingStabilization: Use existing damping as v1 base; add readable effectiveness and explicitly defer or test HoldAttitude behavior.
parityTopics.perMarkerNozzleVisualization: Start with telemetry/descriptor/procedural marker fallback; bind GLB markers only after visual hierarchy stabilizes.
parityTopics.hudTelemetry: Expose mode, throttle command/applied state, RCS/SAS status/effectiveness, command/effective outputs, and no-authority labels.
parityTopics.playwrightEvidence: Manual flight, mode switching, throttle ramp, RCS enabled/disabled, SAS on/off/effectiveness, camera authority isolation, no-snap/no-idle-zero.
parityTopics.noSnapNoIdleZeroRegression: Preserve executor planHash/replanRequired visibility, gradual arrival, manual/autopilot handoff, and idle/manual request continuity.
